title: Add a website to your Home Screen

compatibility.layout: Page Menu → Share → View More → Add to Home Screen
compatibility.note: Source owner reports iOS 27 and Safari 27 on iPhone. Broader compatibility and automatic selection remain unverified.

steps.title: Open the Page Menu
steps.description: Tap the Page Menu button beside the website address.

steps.title: Tap Share
steps.description: In the Page Menu, tap Share.

steps.title: Tap View More
steps.description: If the share sheet is collapsed, tap View More to reveal additional actions.

steps.title: Tap Add to Home Screen
steps.description: Find and tap Add to Home Screen in the expanded action list.

completion.description: Follow the confirmation screen that appears to finish adding the app. The supplied screenshots stop before this screen; a matching illustration still needs verification.

illustration.alt: Four numbered iPhone illustrations showing Page Menu, Share, View More, and Add to Home Screen.
